title: lem-weil-pbc-pullback-iso-torsion-colimit
statement: For schemes X Y, morphism u : Y ⟶ X, compact and quasi-separated, if pullback cohomology is bijective for every sheaf annihilated by a positive integer, then it is bijective for every torsion abelian sheaf F. Notation and conventions are those of [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback], [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf].

proof.text: Use the positive-integer kernel diagram and its colimit cocone from the definition of torsion. Multiplication by n on F[n] vanishes by cancelling the kernel inclusion. The divisibility poset is nonempty and filtered (product is an upper bound).
Inverse image preserves the colimit cocone. Cohomology on X and Y preserves it by filtered-colimit compatibility, transported to Sheaf.H by the natural Ext-to-derived comparison.

Naturality gives a transformation of the cohomology diagrams. hbounded gives bijective components; their inverses are natural by multiplying the commuting squares by inverses. The induced colimit map is bijective and agrees with pullback on F by naturality on each kernel inclusion and uniqueness of colimit descent.
